question: Choose the antonym of 'approve":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reject**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"approve"** means to officially agree to or accept something as satisfactory. (स्वीकृत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The board will approve the budget after reviewing the financial report.
 
 
 
• **"Reject" **refers to refusing to accept, agree with, or consider something or someone. (अस्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The committee decided to reject the proposal due to its high cost.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'approve' **is **'reject'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reject**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sanction **(स्वीकृति): To give official permission or approval for an action.

 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to sanction funds for the development project.
 
 
 
• **Endorse **(समर्थन करना ): To publicly or officially declare support for something.
 
 
• **Example: **The celebrity agreed to endorse the new product in the advertisement.
 
 
 
• **Certify** (प्रमाणित करना): To confirm or attest to something as true, accurate, or meeting a certain standard.
 
 
• **Example:** The inspector will certify the building as safe after a thorough examination.
